newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tenders to import 6.28 mln barrels oil.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tenders to import 6.28 mln barrels oil.

text.p: State-owned Bangladesh Petroleum Corporation (BPC) has invited tenders to import 6.28 million barrels of superior kerosene oil, motor spirit, aviation turbine fuel and high speed diesel for shipment from July to December, BPC officials said on Monday.
Offers will be accepted until 0600 GMT on May 20, they said. The decision on any deal would be finalised by a cabinet meeting by June 10.
The officials said Bangladesh also planned further imports of approximately 7.75 million barrels of oil products for shipment during January-June, 1998.
